title: I quit my job, sold a kidney and gave up my daughter. Now my only hope is this arcade game my AI agents built
author: Helix_abdu2
selftext:
Hello everyone,



I'm an indie dev. Three months ago I fought with my boss, quit my job, sold a kidney to fund my own project, and gave my daughter up for adoption. I want her back. So I made this game.



Everything is automated: AI agents build it, test it, translate it into 30 languages and ship it. My only job is pressing the final Approve button.



Please play it and tell me anything: what to fix, what to change, what to add. You can suggest the next game right inside the app, and the AI reads every suggestion.



My AI insisted I add this line so nobody sues me:

(Ok, only the AI part is true. My kidneys are fine. Please still play the game.)



Google Play: [https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=dev.codeator.arcade](https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=dev.codeator.arcade)

App Store: [https://apps.apple.com/app/id6803009434](https://apps.apple.com/app/id6803009434)

comments.author: Helix_abdu2
comments.body: For the curious, the actual setup: a few Claude Code sessions, each owning one part (the Unity game, store listings, videos), and a coordinator that hands work between them. Anything public waits for my tap on my phone. A lot of the sprites are drawn by C# code the agent wrote, not by an image model, which keeps the style consistent. The hardest part was the 30 languages: Thai line breaks and Arabic right-to-left took several rounds. Ask me anything about the workflow.

comments.author: Chinoui67
comments.body: the hope bar isnt set very high ...

comments.author: tornikeo
comments.body: what the fuck is this slop?

comments.author: mechatui
comments.body:
I did nothing at all and put in zero effort in so please put effort and test the game for me”

Using AI in game dev doesn’t mean everybody here will applaud you creating a AI only pipeline to deliver slop with no input or anything creative outside of just copying existing mobile games. All of those games just look like cheap copies of mobile games.

replies.author: Helix_abdu2
replies.body: Yeah, I oversold the "just press Approve" part. I play every build and send a lot back. Today alone: the trailer music was boring, the game sounds were missing, and the age screen broke Google's family rules, all sent back. But if the games aren't fun, that's on me, not the AI.

comments.author: OriginlessGamer
comments.body: hahah, I've been thinking about making a post like this, you definitely nailed the vibe 😂

comments.author: Blueberry_Gecko
comments.body:
> Please play it and tell me anything

no

comments.author: iolmao
comments.body: Any plans on how to market them in the ocean of other game designers with AI out there?

replies.author: Helix_abdu2
replies.body: I'd focus on making one game worth coming back to, then show it in short gameplay clips. "AI made it" clearly isn't enough of a pitch 😂

comments.author: azicre
comments.body:
A bit of a side tangent but I have always found it interesting how the 'sacrifices' have been growing up to the point of absurd in recent times.

I see all those people saying they 'quit their job' and 'spend all their live's savings' on the game they are making and all I can think is 'when I announce my game I am going to say I quit 2 jobs and took out 6 mortgages' to make my game a reality.

It is all just so funny to me the lengths people go to get eyes on their posts/games.

replies.author: According-Effect3423
replies.body: To be honest  i am thinking about quitting my Job several times (dont WE all? ). I mean every one Here has kinda the Same dream i guess .. but Posts Like These make hesitate ...

replies.author: azicre
replies.body: never quit your job until absolutely can't keep combining the two and your game is actually taking off. try to reduce hours or whatever or literally do anything else besides give up a dependable source of income in times like these.

replies.author: Helix_abdu2
replies.body: Plot twist: the quitting part is real 😂 About 3 months ago. But I had freelance clients first, so you're right, nobody should quit for a game that doesn't pay yet.

comments.author: Easy-Coconut-33
comments.body:
I tried your app! Some of the music was kinda good, rest of the games was pure shit. Im all for using ai in game development but this is not it. 

I also let my son try the games and he agrees with me that is not fun, bad controls and quality isnt there.

replies.author: Helix_abdu2
replies.body: At least the music survived 🥲 Thanks for trying it with your son. Which game had the worst controls? What were you trying to do, and what happened instead?
